title: Adapt existing types to generic operations (preview)
goal: Use preview SRTP resolution to adapt an existing type to a generic F# operation.

selectionNotes: Preview; open the public extension module at the consuming call site.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=preview.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Preview is required for this compiler feature.

constraints: Experimental preview resolution can change. Only public extensions satisfy this contract; ordinary extension calls do not themselves require preview.
The defining module must be in scope. Real or built-in members take precedence; avoid conflicting extensions. This recipe verifies an instance method, not every operator or overload-resolution case.

packages.name: FSharp.Core
packages.reason: FSharp.Core 11 is the library dependency for this edition; the exact compiled RC2 version is recorded separately in evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual FSharpApiPreview compilation and managed execution including generic assertions; separate compiler/external-consumer probes in eng/Test-FSharpBoundaries.ps1. No mocks, cross-compilation, native/AOT deployment or GA execution claimed.
